advanced.description: Build the RAPTOR container image manually.
Process one photogrammetry mission non-interactively (ideal for CI/batch).
Deploy webapp container with explicit flags, bypassing ~/.raptor/config.
Open an interactive bash shell inside the container.

everyday_use.description: Start the webapp background daemon with saved config (~/.raptor/config).
Restart the webapp daemon (same as start).
Check if webapp container is currently running.
Watch live tail logs of webapp background container.
Reconfigure deliveries folder path or listening port.

first_time.description: Build image, install global raptor command on host PATH, configure deliveries folder and port, and launch webapp.

run_flags.description: Path to RGB/thermal flight folder (DJI M3T or H20T).
Path to multispectral 4-band flight folder (DJI M3M).
Quality preset: tactico (rapid field response), cartografico (standard cartography), forense (forensic max detail).
Terrain profile; incremental SfM is enabled across all modern presets to prevent photo drops in steep relief.
Emergency subsampling: process 1 in every N photos (N>=2). Cuts SfM time by ~3x in rugged terrain.
Reuse existing ODM reconstruction stages from --runs directory.
Manual thread limit override for ODM stages. Defaults to memory-safe auto budget.
Force CPU-only execution, disabling CUDA / OpenMVS GPU offload.
Stream raw verbose output from ODM and core subroutines.
Host destination folder for exported GIS deliverables.
Comma-separated products or 'all': rgb, thermal, dsm, multispectral, indices, classes, confidence, area, flight_path, situation, pointclouds.
Target CRS EPSG code (e.g. 9377 for MAGNA-SIRGAS Origen Nacional Colombia) or 'source'.
Raster format: Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF (cog) or standard GeoTIFF (gtiff).
Vector format for boundaries, flight path, and incident situation summary.
Persistent working and caching scratch directory.
Output machine-readable run summary JSON upon completion.
Keep interactive geovisor HTTP server running upon mission completion.
Port for geovisor server when --serve is passed.
